page_title: ATA 2-1 UDI | Atalanta v Udinese 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+1' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Di Bello had an easy-decision to make.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 8:11.
87' Substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta).
87' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
84' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Isaak Toure (Udinese) for his blatant foul.
82' A long cross into the box finds Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) unmarked, but his header from the edge of the six-yard box is wild and goes miles wide of the left post.
80' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
78' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Keinan Davis will be replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Lautaro Giannetti as he is replaced by James Abankwah (Udinese).
76' Isak Hien (Atalanta) commits a rough foul. Marco Di Bello stops the game and makes a call.
74' A pass by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
73' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
71' 4:5 – the corner kicks stats.
69' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Substitution. Lazar Samardzic makes way for Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
68' Here comes a substitution. Mateo Retegui is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta).
67' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Florian Thauvin is replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
67' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hassane Kamara.
65' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
64' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
60' 2 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Isaak Toure (Udinese), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:1.
60' That will be all from Sandi Lovric who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
59' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 62:38.
56' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Raoul Bellanova laid the ball off to Mario Pasalic (Atalanta), who shot from close range into the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
54' Udinese work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
54' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

53' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
52' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.

51' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Marco Carnesecchi pulls off an easy save.
50' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
48' It looks like Jaka Bijol (Udinese) saw red with that tackle. Marco Di Bello won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
46' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini makes a switch. Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is coming on in place of Davide Zappacosta at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+3' 0 - 1 Hassane Kamara (Udinese) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight inside the right post. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.
45+2' Atalanta get a corner.
45+1' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Corner kicks – 2:2.
40' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' A spell of possession for Udinese in an attempt to control the game.
36' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) commits a foul and Marco Di Bello immediately signals a free kick.
34' Atalanta will take a corner kick.
32' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
29' The total number of attempts is 3:5.
27' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
26' Marco Di Bello has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta).
25' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' Gian Piero Gasperini is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Berat Djimsiti suffers an injury and Ederson (Atalanta) comes on.
22' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) picks up an injury.
22' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
22' A snap shot by Florian Thauvin (Udinese) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi produces a good save to thwart him.
20' Chance! Martin Payero (Udinese) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Carnesecchi is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
18' Martin Payero (Udinese) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the bar. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
16' 56:44 – the latest ball possession ratio.
15' The goal by Atalanta won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
14' Wait! Referee Marco Di Bello has indicated he is going to review the Atalanta goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
13' The ball finds its way to Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 1:0.
12' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
9' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Maduka Okoye, who smothers the ball.
8' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
7' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marco Carnesecchi.
7' Atalanta keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
5' The corner is flicked onto Mateo Retegui (Atalanta), but his close-range header flies just over the bar.
5' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is about to take a corner kick.
5' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atalanta are going to take it.
4' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
3' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Udinese will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Marco Di Bello.
